article.story: BOSTON -- — Colby Duggan scored 22 points, every player who scored for Boston College reached double digits, and the Eagles eased past NJIT 79-59 on Sunday. Zak Smrekar scored 16 points and Brandon Benjamin 11 for the Eagles (6-0). Ernest Shelton, Armoni Zeigler and Andrija Bukumirovic all scored 10. Mario Tatum Jr. scored 18 points and David Bolden 11 for NJIT (1-7). Duggan's 13 points in the first half included three 3-pointers and the Eagles led 41-31 at the break. BC outshot the Highlanders 53%-44% and had 10 assists on 16 made baskets. For the game, the Eagles had 18 assists on 28 makes. A 10-0 scoring run early in the second half gave Boston College a 17-point lead and the Eagles led by double figures the rest of the way. NJIT made one push and the score was 64-54 after a 3-pointer by Tatum. Boston College responded with 13 of the next 15 points and the score was 77-56 with two minutes left in the game. The Eagles last started 6-0 in the 2005-06 season. Up next Boston College: The Eagles play UCF on Thursday to open the ESPN Events Invitational in Kissimmee, Fla. NJIT: The Highlanders host Manhattan on Wednesday. -------- Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here.
